module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Orphan Child Order Auto-Cleanup on Parent Order Cancellation
precondition: Master cancels parent order while 2 child orders are in-flight.
expected_result: In-flight child orders cancelled or closed immediately; zero orphan positions left active.
actual_result: Parent order cancellation initiates downstream cascade cancelling all associated in-flight child tickets.
